rituals.hook: The Two-Tray Test: Emotional reasoning gets smaller here. Target: A loud conclusion still has to pass inspection.

rituals.unique_game_move: Imagine Trays opens; Sort Facts pivots. Endpoint: Balance Verdict.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Emotional reasoning

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
The Two-Tray Test: Emotional reasoning gets smaller here. Target: A loud conclusion still has to pass inspection.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A loud conclusion still has to pass inspection.

GAME MOVE
Imagine Trays opens; Sort Facts pivots. Endpoint: Balance Verdict.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Imagine Trays — Imagine two trays.
2. Name Sides — Name the left SUPPORTS IT and the right DOESN’T FIT.
3. Sort Facts — Drop only visible facts into them—no feelings disguised as evidence.
4. Switch Sides — Now cover the fuller tray and read the neglected one aloud.
5. Balance Verdict — Finish with a verdict that can hold both sides without pretending they weigh the same.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

TRIGGER
Catastrophic prediction

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
Worst Case, With Exits: Catastrophising gets smaller here. Test this: A worst-case story loses size when it gains a route.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A worst-case story loses size when it gains a route.

GAME MOVE
Name Fear opens; Add Likely pivots. Close with Act Now.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name Fear — Picture the feared ending in one line.
2. Build Exits — Under it build four rungs: WHAT HAPPENS; WHAT I DO NEXT; WHO OR WHAT HELPS; HOW RECOVERY COULD BEGIN.
3. Add Likely — Add a fifth rung for the outcome that is actually most likely.
4. Climb Route — Move through the five steps once in your mind.
5. Act Now — Then take the first coping action available now.

FINISH MOVE — Act Now is your cue to stop.

rituals.name: THE GREY DIAL
rituals.hook: The Grey Dial: Black-and-white thinking gets smaller here. Stay here: Binary thinking hates a numbered dial.
rituals.recognition_cue: The Grey Dial: Black-and-white thinking gets smaller here. Stay here: Binary thinking hates a numbered dial.

rituals.unique_game_move: Name Extremes opens; Place Today pivots. End when Choose Response completes.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Evidence distortion & selective thinking

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
The Grey Dial: Black-and-white thinking gets smaller here. Stay here: Binary thinking hates a numbered dial.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Binary thinking hates a numbered dial.

GAME MOVE
Name Extremes opens; Place Today pivots. End when Choose Response completes.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name Extremes — Name the two extremes your mind is using.
2. Build Scale — Build a 0–10 scale between them and say three real anchor points: 2, 5, and 8.
3. Place Today — Place today’s event where the evidence fits—not where the emotion shouts.
4. Choose Response — Choose a response matched to that exact setting.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
The Grey Dial proves this: binary thinking hates a numbered dial. No second proof after Choose Response.
rituals.formula_flow: Name Extremes → Build Scale → Place Today → Choose Response
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Stop if grading becomes another perfection test.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

TRIGGER
Urges, impulses & cravings

about 1 minute

Reverse The Urge, Completely interrupts Impulse fusion. Target: When the emotion is unjustified, half-opposites do not retrain it.

3. Match Posture — Match posture, words, and behaviour until the new signal is coherent.

Identify Chapter first. Pause Meaning carries the middle. Sequence closes: Continue Genuine.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A memory matters without every detail carrying equal certainty.

GAME MOVE
Begin Pick Detail; hinge on Rate Confidence. Finish at Keep Core; move on.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Pick Detail — Choose one small memory detail; do not replay the event.
2. Tag Source — Stamp it SENSED, INFERRED, LEARNED LATER, or UNSURE.
3. Rate Confidence — Give the detail a confidence word—high, medium, low, or unknown—based on its source rather than its emotional intensity.
4. Keep Core — Picture one core fact that remains reliable and let the other detail keep its honest uncertainty.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.hook: Ocean In The Throat tests Breath-control overeffort directly. Purpose: Use barely audible sound as a pace rail.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Ocean In The Throat tests Breath-control overeffort directly. Purpose: Use barely audible sound as a pace rail.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Use barely audible sound as a pace rail.

GAME MOVE
Use Create Soft; work through Reduce Effort. After Release Technique, return.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Create Soft — Narrow the throat only enough to create a soft ocean texture, never a rasp.
2. Let Sound — Let that sound accompany an easy inhale and exhale.
3. Reduce Effort — Reduce effort until someone beside you might barely hear it.
4. Release Technique — After several waves, release the technique completely.

FINISH MOVE — Release Technique is your cue to stop.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Ocean In The Throat gives one sign: use barely audible sound as a pace rail. Once Release Technique happens, stop.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.hook: Bring Install The Counter-Quality to Body alarm escalation. Finish criterion: Do not wrestle a harmful tendency on its own ground.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
Bring Install The Counter-Quality to Body alarm escalation. Finish criterion: Do not wrestle a harmful tendency on its own ground.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Do not wrestle a harmful tendency on its own ground.

GAME MOVE
4 moves: Name Active into Keep Credible. Last decision: Train.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name Active — Name the active pattern and the wholesome quality opposite with it: cruelty/kindness, panic/steadiness, greed/sufficiency.
2. Act Counter — Produce one thought, posture, and act expressing the counter-quality.
3. Keep Credible — Keep it credible rather than grand.
4. Train — Train the opposite channel through embodiment.

FINISH MOVE — Let Train be enough.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Call Install The Counter-Quality complete here: do not wrestle a harmful tendency on its own ground. Keep evidence; leave at Train.
rituals.formula_flow: Name Active → Act Counter → Keep Credible → Train
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Countering must not suppress valid grief, anger, or protective fear.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Stabilise — Stabilise attention on one simple form.
2. Remove Name — Gradually remove its name, meaning, shape, and boundary in that order.
3. Attend Object — Preserve the ongoing sense of attending as the object loses definition.
4. Rest Briefly — Rest briefly with contact that no longer depends on a clear thing.

TRIGGER
Boundaries & over-responsibility

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
Bring Erase The Object, Keep The Contact to Boundary confusion. Keep the task narrow: Let focus outlive its original target.

GOAL
Let focus outlive its original target.

GAME MOVE
4 moves: Stabilise into Attend Object. Stopping line: Rest Briefly.

1. Stabilise — Stabilise attention on one simple form.
2. Remove Name — Gradually remove its name, meaning, shape, and boundary in that order.
3. Attend Object — Preserve the ongoing sense of attending as the object loses definition.
4. Rest Briefly — Rest briefly with contact that no longer depends on a clear thing.

WIN SIGNAL
Call Erase The Object, Keep The Contact complete here: let focus outlive its original target. Final marker: Rest Briefly.

FORMULA FLOW
Stabilise → Remove Name → Attend Object → Rest Briefly

rituals.name: THE FIVE-LAYER INSPECTION
rituals.hook: The Five-Layer Inspection loosens Body-state misreading. One job: Identity may be wearing several visible coats.
rituals.recognition_cue: The Five-Layer Inspection loosens Body-state misreading. One job: Identity may be wearing several visible coats.

rituals.mission: Identity may be wearing several visible coats.
rituals.challenge: Identity may be wearing several visible coats.
rituals.immediate_need: Identity may be wearing several visible coats.
rituals.game_move: Take Move Body; keep Keep All Layers literal. Place Like lands; leave it.
rituals.unique_game_move: Take Move Body; keep Keep All Layers literal. Place Like lands; leave it.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Body-state misreading

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
The Five-Layer Inspection loosens Body-state misreading. One job: Identity may be wearing several visible coats.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Identity may be wearing several visible coats.

GAME MOVE
Take Move Body; keep Keep All Layers literal. Place Like lands; leave it.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Move Body — Move through body, energy, mind, intellect, and deep ease.
2. Ask Change — At each layer ask what is present, what changes, and how it is known.
3. Keep All Layers — Do not discard any layer.
4. Place Like — Place them like translucent sheets within awareness, then select the layer needed for practical action.

FINISH MOVE — Place Like closes the round.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
The Five-Layer Inspection earns its finish: identity may be wearing several visible coats. Let Place Like be enough.
rituals.formula_flow: Move Body → Ask Change → Keep All Layers → Place Like
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Avoid abstract layer work when immediate grounding is needed.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.unique_game_move: Take Event frames it; Identify Facts tests it. Stop at Try Construction.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Comparison & rejection

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
For Comparison distortion, open The Waking Dream Check. Aim: Meaning builds worlds more quickly than we notice.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Meaning builds worlds more quickly than we notice.

GAME MOVE
Take Event frames it; Identify Facts tests it. Stop at Try Construction.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Take Event — Take one rigid reading of an event.
2. Compare Dream — Compare it with a dream: both organise fragments into a convincing world.
3. Identify Facts — Spot which facts are raw and which connections were constructed.
4. Try Construction — Try one alternate construction and observe how lived experience changes.

FINISH MOVE — Try Construction closes the round.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Keep The Waking Dream Check small: meaning builds worlds more quickly than we notice. End once Try Construction arrives.
rituals.formula_flow: Take Event → Compare Dream → Identify Facts → Try Construction
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Avoid dreamlike framing if it increases derealisation or psychotic symptoms.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

2. Compare Dream — Compare it with a dream: both organise fragments into a convincing world.
3. Identify Facts — Spot which facts are raw and which connections were constructed.
4. Try Construction — Try one alternate construction and observe how lived experience changes.

⚡ FINISH — Try Construction closes the round.

TRIGGER

PLAY TIME

HOOK

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Inner agreement is optional; a move that betrays no red line is enough.

GAME MOVE
Begin Seat Feelings; no side task before Clear Board. Sequence closes: Choose Survivor.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Seat Feelings — Name up to three active emotions as players at the table. Leave them unnamed for the moment; observe first.
2. Vetoes — Give each emotion one veto: ‘Fear will not accept ___. Anger will not accept ___. Sadness will not accept ___.’
3. Clear Board — Cross out actions blocked by any safe, reasonable veto. Ignore demands for harm, punishment, or impossible certainty.
4. Choose Survivor — Choose one remaining action that crosses no red line, even if no feeling loves it.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Find The Move No Feeling Must Betray has one checkpoint: inner agreement is optional; a move that betrays no red line is enough. Choose Survivor closes it.

rituals.plain:
FIND THE MOVE NO FEELING MUST BETRAY

TRIGGER
Communication & conflict

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
Meet Conflict escalation with Find The Move No Feeling Must Betray. One shift: Inner agreement is optional; a move that betrays no red line is enough.

GOAL
Inner agreement is optional; a move that betrays no red line is enough.

GAME MOVE
Begin Seat Feelings; no side task before Clear Board. Sequence closes: Choose Survivor.

1. Seat Feelings — Name up to three active emotions as players at the table. Leave them unnamed for the moment; observe first.
2. Vetoes — Give each emotion one veto: ‘Fear will not accept ___. Anger will not accept ___. Sadness will not accept ___.’
3. Clear Board — Cross out actions blocked by any safe, reasonable veto. Ignore demands for harm, punishment, or impossible certainty.
4. Choose Survivor — Choose one remaining action that crosses no red line, even if no feeling loves it.

WIN SIGNAL
Find The Move No Feeling Must Betray has one checkpoint: inner agreement is optional; a move that betrays no red line is enough. Choose Survivor closes it.

FORMULA FLOW
Seat Feelings → Vetoes → Clear Board → Choose Survivor

GAME MOVE
Begin Choose Positive; no side task before Ask Brave. Let Evidence arrives; experiment over.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Choose Positive — Choose a positive quality that feels ‘not me.’ Perform one behaviour expressing it without telling anyone or using the quality word.
2. Ask Brave — Ask the brave question, make the playful Notice, accept the compliment, offer the clear boundary.
3. Let Evidence — Let evidence arrive before identity approval.

FINISH MOVE — Complete Let Evidence, then return to your day.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Past helplessness should not inherit present equipment.

GAME MOVE
Imagine Two Sides to Picture Today; no rewind. Let Use One Resource finish.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Imagine Two Sides — Imagine two sides.
2. Then — On the first side, picture your age, knowledge, money, power, support, and choices then.
3. Picture Today — On the second side, picture the same things today.
4. Find The Change — Notice what gives you more choice now.
5. Use One Resource — Pick one resource you have today and use it in one small action.

FINISH MOVE — Complete Use One Resource, then return to your day.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Power Then, Resources Now did its job if: past helplessness should not inherit present equipment. End with Use One Resource.

TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Power Then, Resources Now changes the angle on Action avoidance. Keep this aim: Past helplessness should not inherit present equipment.

GOAL
Past helplessness should not inherit present equipment.

GAME MOVE
Imagine Two Sides to Picture Today; no rewind. Let Use One Resource finish.

1. Imagine Two Sides — Imagine two sides.
2. Then — On the first side, picture your age, knowledge, money, power, support, and choices then.
3. Picture Today — On the second side, picture the same things today.
4. Find The Change — Notice what gives you more choice now.
5. Use One Resource — Pick one resource you have today and use it in one small action.

FINISH MOVE — Complete Use One Resource, then return to your day.

WIN SIGNAL
Power Then, Resources Now did its job if: past helplessness should not inherit present equipment. End with Use One Resource.

FORMULA FLOW
Imagine Two Sides → Then → Picture Today → Find The Change → Use One Resource

rituals.title: POSTURE WITHOUT PROPHECY
rituals.name: POSTURE WITHOUT PROPHECY
rituals.hook: When the mind compresses the situation too quickly, Posture Without Prophecy opens one useful distinction. The body can stop rehearsing defeat before facts arrive.
rituals.recognition_cue: When the mind compresses the situation too quickly, Posture Without Prophecy opens one useful distinction. The body can stop rehearsing defeat before facts arrive.
rituals.goal: The body can stop rehearsing defeat before facts arrive.
rituals.mission: The body can stop rehearsing defeat before facts arrive.
rituals.challenge: The body can stop rehearsing defeat before facts arrive.
rituals.immediate_need: The body can stop rehearsing defeat before facts arrive.
rituals.game_move: Adopt opens; Hold Posture changes the angle. Leave it at Hold Posture.
rituals.unique_game_move: Adopt opens; Hold Posture changes the angle. Leave it at Hold Posture.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
When the mind compresses the situation too quickly, Posture Without Prophecy opens one useful distinction. The body can stop rehearsing defeat before facts arrive.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
The body can stop rehearsing defeat before facts arrive.

GAME MOVE
Adopt opens; Hold Posture changes the angle. Leave it at Hold Posture.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Adopt — Adopt a stable, non-defensive position: feet supported, spine available, gaze level, arms unguarded enough for safety. clearly refuse both positive and negative…
2. Hold Posture — Hold the posture while waiting for actual evidence.

FINISH MOVE — Hold Posture is your cue to stop.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Let Posture Without Prophecy end with this: the body can stop rehearsing defeat before facts arrive. Exit on Hold Posture.
rituals.formula_flow: Adopt → Hold Posture
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Choose protective posture and distance in genuinely threatening settings.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.title: LET THE SHAKE BE SMALL
rituals.name: LET THE SHAKE BE SMALL
rituals.hook: Let The Shake Be Small is a small reality check for a pattern that likes sweeping conclusions. Trembling is movement, not automatic evidence of collapse.

30–60 seconds

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Trembling is movement, not automatic evidence of collapse.

GAME MOVE
Medically opens; Let Migrate changes the angle. Ground arrives; experiment over.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Medically — If medically safe and oriented, permit a small tremor rather than clamping it down.
2. Track Location — Track its location, rhythm, and whether choice remains intact.
3. Let Migrate — Let it stop, continue, or migrate without exaggeration.
4. Ground — Ground afterward.

FINISH MOVE — Complete Ground, then return to your day.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Trembling is movement, not automatic evidence of collapse. When Let The Shake Be Small reaches Ground, leave it there.

Trembling is movement, not automatic evidence of collapse.

1. Medically — If medically safe and oriented, permit a small tremor rather than clamping it down.
2. Track Location — Track its location, rhythm, and whether choice remains intact.
3. Let Migrate — Let it stop, continue, or migrate without exaggeration.
4. Ground — Ground afterward.

⚡ DONE — Complete Ground, then return to your day.
rituals.win_reward_source:
🏆 WIN
Trembling is movement, not automatic evidence of collapse. When Let The Shake Be Small reaches Ground, leave it there.

rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name Lost — Name what the lost person, role, place, or ability allowed you to express—care, mastery, belonging, beauty, service.
2. Find Different — Find a different, honest channel for a small portion of that value.
3. Start — Begin without treating substitution as replacement.

FINISH MOVE — Start is your cue to stop.

rituals.hook: At Impulse fusion, reach for Play Emotion Jenga. Use this target: Pull one feeling from the stack and see what is actually holding.
rituals.recognition_cue: At Impulse fusion, reach for Play Emotion Jenga. Use this target: Pull one feeling from the stack and see what is actually holding.

rituals.challenge: Pull one feeling from the stack and see what is actually holding.

rituals.game_move: Name Stack gets first beat; Check Remainder is pivot. Exit at Rebuild Stack.
rituals.unique_game_move: Name Stack gets first beat; Check Remainder is pivot. Exit at Rebuild Stack.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Urges, impulses & cravings

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
At Impulse fusion, reach for Play Emotion Jenga. Use this target: Pull one feeling from the stack and see what is actually holding.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Pull one feeling from the stack and see what is actually holding.

GAME MOVE
Name Stack gets first beat; Check Remainder is pivot. Exit at Rebuild Stack.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name Stack — Name two or three feelings and place each on a separate mental or your imagination block.
2. Pull One — Temporarily bracket one block with the phrase ‘not deleted—just outside this test.’
3. Check Remainder — Notice what changes in the remainder: body location, urge, story, intensity, or nothing at all. Keep one difference.
4. Rebuild Stack — Restore the removed block. Repeat only if useful, then rebuild the complete stack before finishing.

FINISH MOVE — Rebuild Stack closes the round.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Play Emotion Jenga is useful if: pull one feeling from the stack and see what is actually holding. Round ends at Rebuild Stack.
rituals.formula_flow: Name Stack → Pull One → Check Remainder → Rebuild Stack
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Stop if the game causes numbness, feeling unreal or disconnected, suppression, or pressure to erase a valid feeling.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

items.play_the_loop:
1. Trigger — A trigger flickers.
2. Pause Story — Do not explain it yet.
3. Capture Thought — Pin the first mental sentence, picture, or prediction exactly as it arrived.
4. Quote — Put quotation marks around it.
5. Close Capture — The catch ends there; no life story, no courtroom, no spiral.

FINISH MOVE — Close Capture closes the round.

items.play_the_loop:
1. Imagine Trays — Imagine two trays.
2. Name Sides — Name the left SUPPORTS IT and the right DOESN’T FIT.
3. Sort Facts — Drop only visible facts into them—no feelings disguised as evidence.
4. Switch Sides — Now cover the fuller tray and read the neglected one aloud.
5. Balance Verdict — Finish with a verdict that can hold both sides without pretending they weigh the same.

Name Fear opens; Add Likely pivots. Close with Act Now.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Name Fear — Picture the feared ending in one line.
2. Build Exits — Under it build four rungs: WHAT HAPPENS; WHAT I DO NEXT; WHO OR WHAT HELPS; HOW RECOVERY COULD BEGIN.
3. Add Likely — Add a fifth rung for the outcome that is actually most likely.
4. Climb Route — Move through the five steps once in your mind.
5. Act Now — Then take the first coping action available now.

FINISH MOVE — Act Now is your cue to stop.

items.plain:
THE FORECAST SCOREBOARD

TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Make a prediction, let reality answer, then score the gap. THE FORECAST SCOREBOARD turns vague expectation into something your memory can actually update.

GOAL
Memory edits its predictions after the result.

GAME MOVE
Count Hit opens; Calculate pivots. Finish Look Recurring; skip rechecking.

1. Count Hit — Before an uncertain event, remember four items: forecast, confidence %, deadline, and what counts as a hit.
2. Keep Result — Afterward, Hold the result without rewriting the original entry.
3. Calculate — Calculate the gap between confidence and reality.
4. Look Recurring — After five rounds, look for your recurring bias.

WIN SIGNAL
The Forecast Scoreboard proves this: memory edits its predictions after the result. Nothing owed after Look Recurring.

FORMULA FLOW
Count Hit → Keep Result → Calculate → Look Recurring

2. Select Option — During a spike, select the first available option without browsing for the perfect one.
3. Finish Interval — Finish the interval, reassess safety, then either return or choose support.

HOOK

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A memory matters without every detail carrying equal certainty.

GAME MOVE
Begin Pick Detail; hinge on Rate Confidence. Finish at Keep Core; move on.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Pick Detail — Choose one small memory detail; do not replay the event.
2. Tag Source — Stamp it SENSED, INFERRED, LEARNED LATER, or UNSURE.
3. Rate Confidence — Give the detail a confidence word—high, medium, low, or unknown—based on its source rather than its emotional intensity.
4. Keep Core — Picture one core fact that remains reliable and let the other detail keep its honest uncertainty.

Stamp Where The Detail Came From earns the stop at Keep Core when a memory matters without every detail carrying equal certainty.

PAUSE
Do not force missing details; stop and seek support if the memory becomes overwhelming or disorienting.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Body-state misreading

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Identity may be wearing several visible coats.

GAME MOVE
Take Move Body; keep Keep All Layers literal. Place Like lands; leave it.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Move Body — Move through body, energy, mind, intellect, and deep ease.
2. Ask Change — At each layer ask what is present, what changes, and how it is known.
3. Keep All Layers — Do not discard any layer.
4. Place Like — Place them like translucent sheets within awareness, then select the layer needed for practical action.

FINISH MOVE — Place Like closes the round.
items.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
The Five-Layer Inspection earns its finish: identity may be wearing several visible coats. Let Place Like be enough.
items.formula_flow: Move Body → Ask Change → Keep All Layers → Place Like
items.safety:
PAUSE
Avoid abstract layer work when immediate grounding is needed.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Comparison & rejection

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
For Comparison distortion, open The Waking Dream Check. Aim: Meaning builds worlds more quickly than we notice.
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Meaning builds worlds more quickly than we notice.

GAME MOVE
Take Event frames it; Identify Facts tests it. Stop at Try Construction.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Take Event — Take one rigid reading of an event.
2. Compare Dream — Compare it with a dream: both organise fragments into a convincing world.
3. Identify Facts — Spot which facts are raw and which connections were constructed.
4. Try Construction — Try one alternate construction and observe how lived experience changes.

FINISH MOVE — Try Construction closes the round.
items.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Keep The Waking Dream Check small: meaning builds worlds more quickly than we notice. End once Try Construction arrives.
items.formula_flow: Take Event → Compare Dream → Identify Facts → Try Construction
items.safety:
PAUSE
Avoid dreamlike framing if it increases derealisation or psychotic symptoms.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

Start Brief frames it; Include Conventional tests it. Last decision: Test Feasibility.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Start Brief — Start a brief timer and generate options without ranking, explaining, or defending them.
2. Include Conventional — Include one conventional, one tiny, one reversible, one collaborative, and one strange-but-safe possibility.
3. Test Feasibility — Only after the timer ends may feasibility enter the room.

FINISH MOVE — Let Test Feasibility be enough.

WIN SIGNAL
The No-Judgement Option Storm leaves one useful fact behind: evaluation kills possibilities before they are born. Stop after Test Feasibility.

items.play_the_loop:
1. Identify Novelty — Spot the novelty source pulling attention away.
2. Add Controlled — Add controlled variety to the desired task instead: change order, tool, location, soundtrack, colour, or challenge.
3. Keep Goal — Keep the goal constant while refreshing the route.

FINISH MOVE — Let Keep Goal be enough.

items.play_the_loop:
1. Name Object — Name the exact OBJECT currently carrying the task: document, pan, form, email, shelf, or tool.
2. Place — Notice the precise LOCATION inside it: paragraph three, top-left field, second burner, or blue tab.

4. Reenter — After the interruption, say the three-part address once and act on the verb without rescanning the entire task.

items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Communication & conflict

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
Meet Conflict escalation with Find The Move No Feeling Must Betray. One shift: Inner agreement is optional; a move that betrays no red line is enough.
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Inner agreement is optional; a move that betrays no red line is enough.

GAME MOVE
Begin Seat Feelings; no side task before Clear Board. Sequence closes: Choose Survivor.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Seat Feelings — Name up to three active emotions as players at the table. Leave them unnamed for the moment; observe first.
2. Vetoes — Give each emotion one veto: ‘Fear will not accept ___. Anger will not accept ___. Sadness will not accept ___.’
3. Clear Board — Cross out actions blocked by any safe, reasonable veto. Ignore demands for harm, punishment, or impossible certainty.
4. Choose Survivor — Choose one remaining action that crosses no red line, even if no feeling loves it.
items.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Find The Move No Feeling Must Betray has one checkpoint: inner agreement is optional; a move that betrays no red line is enough. Choose Survivor closes it.
items.formula_flow: Seat Feelings → Vetoes → Clear Board → Choose Survivor
items.safety:
PAUSE
Safety, consent, law, and basic care outrank every emotional veto; seek support if no safe move remains.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

GOAL
A state is not licensed to Think of a permanent biography.

GAME MOVE
Begin State Conditions; no side task before Identify Condition. Last decision: Identify Condition.
items.play_the_loop:
1. State Conditions — Append this qualifier to the self-judgement: ‘in this state, under these conditions, for now.’ Name the state and conditions precisely.
2. Identify Condition — Then spot one condition likely to change and one action that could influence it.

FINISH MOVE — Let Identify Condition be enough.

items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Power Then, Resources Now changes the angle on Action avoidance. Keep this aim: Past helplessness should not inherit present equipment.
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Past helplessness should not inherit present equipment.

GAME MOVE
Imagine Two Sides to Picture Today; no rewind. Let Use One Resource finish.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Imagine Two Sides — Imagine two sides.
2. Then — On the first side, picture your age, knowledge, money, power, support, and choices then.
3. Picture Today — On the second side, picture the same things today.
4. Find The Change — Notice what gives you more choice now.
5. Use One Resource — Pick one resource you have today and use it in one small action.

FINISH MOVE — Complete Use One Resource, then return to your day.
items.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Power Then, Resources Now did its job if: past helplessness should not inherit present equipment. End with Use One Resource.
items.formula_flow: Imagine Two Sides → Then → Picture Today → Find The Change → Use One Resource

Acknowledge areas where present power is still limited.

GOAL
Pull one feeling from the stack and see what is actually holding.

GAME MOVE
Name Stack gets first beat; Check Remainder is pivot. Exit at Rebuild Stack.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Name Stack — Name two or three feelings and place each on a separate mental or your imagination block.
2. Pull One — Temporarily bracket one block with the phrase ‘not deleted—just outside this test.’
3. Check Remainder — Notice what changes in the remainder: body location, urge, story, intensity, or nothing at all. Keep one difference.
4. Rebuild Stack — Restore the removed block. Repeat only if useful, then rebuild the complete stack before finishing.

FINISH MOVE — Rebuild Stack closes the round.
